briefdescription.para: NeedLatency - True if the scheduler will make use of latency information.
AvailableQueue - The priority queue to use for the available SUnits.
PendingQueue - This contains all of the instructions whose operands have been issued, but their results are not ready yet (due to the latency of the operation).

detaileddescription.para: Once the operands becomes available, the instruction is added to the AvailableQueue.

briefdescription.para: HazardRec - The hazard recognizer to use.
CurCycle - The current scheduler state corresponds to this cycle.
MinAvailableCycle - Cycle of the soonest available instruction.
IssueCount - Count instructions issued in this cycle Currently valid only for bottom-up scheduling.
LiveRegDefs - A set of physical registers and their definition that are "live".

detaileddescription.para: These nodes must be scheduled before any other nodes that modifies the registers can be scheduled.

briefdescription.para: Topo - A topological ordering for SUnits which permits fast IsReachable and similar queries.
Schedule - Schedule the DAG using list scheduling.
IsReachable - Checks if SU is reachable from TargetSU.
WillCreateCycle - Returns true if adding an edge from SU to TargetSU will create a cycle.
AddPredQueued - Queues and update to add a predecessor edge to SUnit SU.

detaileddescription.para: This returns true if this is a new predecessor. Does NOT update the topological ordering! It just queues an update.

briefdescription.para: AddPred - adds a predecessor edge to SUnit SU.

detaileddescription.para: This returns true if this is a new predecessor. Updates the topological ordering if required.

briefdescription.para: RemovePred - removes a predecessor edge from SUnit SU.

detaileddescription.para: This returns true if an edge was removed. Updates the topological ordering if required.

briefdescription.para: ReleasePred - Decrement the NumSuccsLeft count of a predecessor.

detaileddescription.para: Add it to the AvailableQueue if the count reaches zero. Also update its cycle bound.

briefdescription.para: Call ReleasePred for each predecessor, then update register live def/gen.

detaileddescription.para: Always update LiveRegDefs for a register dependence even if the current SU also defines the register. This effectively create one large live range across a sequence of two-address node. This is important because the entire chain must be scheduled together. Example:
flags = (3) add flags = (2) addc flags flags = (1) addc flags
If (2) addc is unscheduled, then (1) addc must also be unscheduled to avoid interference on flags.

briefdescription.para: Check to see if any of the pending instructions are ready to issue.

detaileddescription.para: If so, add them to the available queue.

briefdescription.para: Move the scheduler state forward by the specified number of Cycles.
Move the scheduler state forward until the specified node's dependents are ready and can be scheduled with no resource conflicts.
Record this SUnit in the HazardRecognizer.
ScheduleNodeBottomUp - Add the node to the schedule.

detaileddescription.para: Decrement the pending count of its predecessors. If a predecessor pending count is zero, add it to the Available queue.

briefdescription.para: CapturePred - This does the opposite of ReleasePred.

detaileddescription.para: Since SU is being unscheduled, increase the succ left count of its predecessors. Remove them from AvailableQueue if necessary.

briefdescription.para: UnscheduleNodeBottomUp - Remove the node from the schedule, update its and its predecessor states to reflect the change.
After backtracking, the hazard checker needs to be restored to a state corresponding the current cycle.
BacktrackBottomUp - Backtrack scheduling to a previous cycle specified in BTCycle in order to schedule a specific node.
TryUnfold - Attempt to unfold.
CopyAndMoveSuccessors - Clone the specified node and move its scheduled successors to the newly created node.

memberdef.argsstring: (SUnit *, unsigned, const TargetRegisterClass *, const TargetRegisterClass *, SmallVectorImpl< SUnit * > &)
memberdef.name: InsertCopiesAndMoveSuccs

briefdescription.para: InsertCopiesAndMoveSuccs - Insert register copies and move all scheduled successors of the given SUnit to the last copy.
DelayForLiveRegsBottomUp - Returns true if it is necessary to delay scheduling of the given node to satisfy live physical register dependencies.

detaileddescription.para: If the specific node is the last one that's available to schedule, do whatever is necessary (i.e. backtracking or cloning) to make it possible.

briefdescription.para: Return a node that can be scheduled in this cycle.

detaileddescription.para: Requirements: (1) Ready: latency has been satisfied (2) No Hazards: resources are available (3) No Interferences: may unschedule to break register interferences.

briefdescription.para: ListScheduleBottomUp - The main loop of list scheduling for bottom-up schedulers.
CreateNewSUnit - Creates a new SUnit and returns a pointer to it.
CreateClone - Creates a new SUnit from an existing one.
forceUnitLatencies - Register-pressure-reducing scheduling doesn't need actual latency information but the hybrid scheduler does.
ScheduleDAGRRList - The actual register reduction list scheduler implementation.

detaileddescription.para: This supports both top-down and bottom-up scheduling.
